longDescription: International Business Operations. Factors Impacting Production. Make or Buy Decisions. Supply Chain Issues. Global Supply Chain Optimisation. Global Marketing Mix. Financing In International Business. Foreign Exchange Risks. Conflict Management. International Negotiations. Ethical Issues In International Business.
